external_games.name: RESONANCE OF FATE/END OF ETERNITY ENHANCED REMASTER

name: Resonance of Fate Enhanced Remaster
storyline:
In the far distant future, humanity clings to existence on a ravaged earth on the brink of collapse. Their only hope for survival lies in “Basel,” a huge machine that controls the environment.

The story beings as the gears continue to spin, humanity is led by a ruling class, which the heroes support as mercenaries.

The fate of the world hangs in the balance as you progress through the many gun fights.
summary:
Resonance of Fate was originally published in 2010 and remastered in 2018 as 4K/HD Editon. This Enhanced Remaster further expands the graphics options, including native 4K output and HDR support.

Traverse this haunted world while getting involved in numerous gun fights, now in even higher-quality, higher-resolution visuals.

The steampunk aesthetic, fateful story, soaring symphonic soundtrack, and intense gun combat for which the game is known now burst to life and play out with even more beautiful graphics.
